tables.name: texel_pitch_by_map_size
tables.units: map_px: pixels per side; pitch: mm per texel; texels_used: millions; layer: MB for one float32 RGB layer
tables.population: Adult head; assumed surface areas: head + neck ~0.16 m^2 (whole-head layout), face alone ~0.04 m^2 (face on its own tile/UDIM); 70% UV fill
tables.notes: Arithmetic: pitch = sqrt(area / (0.7 * N^2)). Surface areas are rough assumptions (rule of nines), consistent with blender/skin-shading.md Table D.

tables.name: capture_gsd_vs_recommended_map
tables.units: field_mm: framed long side in mm; gsd: mm per pixel
tables.population: Adult head framed at 400 mm long side; GSD from reconstruction/photogrammetry-heads.md Table 2
tables.notes: Rule: choose N so texel pitch is ~1-1.5x the best-view GSD. Phone effective resolution (50-70% of nominal) is contested; best-view GSD grows by 1/cos(theta) for regions not facing any camera.

tables.name: incidence_angle_factors
tables.units: theta in degrees; other columns dimensionless
tables.population: Any surface; skin specular F0 = 0.028 from IOR ~1.4
tables.notes: Arithmetic. Weight w = vis * cos^p(theta); p=2 default (contested 1-4). Schlick approximation F = F0 + (1-F0)(1-cos)^5.

tables.name: misregistration_shift
tables.units: delta_n and shift in mm; shift_px at 0.067 mm/px
tables.population: Derived geometry: shift = delta_n * tan(theta); two views at +/-theta disagree by about twice the shift
tables.notes: Typical delta_n per source is an expert estimate; the shift formula is first-order (small errors, locally planar surface).

tables.name: texture_engine_defaults
rows: SH order (9 coeffs per channel at order 2)
tables.population: Proposed defaults for a numpy photo-to-UV texture module (face3d/texture), adult heads, 0.05-0.2 mm/px capture
tables.notes: Starting values from expert practice, to be tuned on synthetic renders (face3d/synthetic.py) and real capture sets; per-row status given in the status column.
